name: BetaFPV 0702 25000kV
description: BetaFPV's freestyle 0702 for the Air65 II: 25000kV, brass bushings, 1.5 g. Fitted to a flying Air65 II's blackbox logs (rpm against motor command, battery current): about 27000 rpm and 2.5 A at hover, 53000 rpm flat out on a tired pack, idling at 3000-4000 rpm. Resistance covers the motor, ESC and wiring.
